title: Malik at the study door
_note: Locked dialogue from docs/VERTICAL_SLICE_SCRIPT.md. Arabic lives here, never in C++ source. Optional. First on the cut list if a rehearsal exceeds 45 minutes.

lines.speaker: Malik
lines.en: The heir is inspecting what he has been given. That is what responsible men do.
lines.ar: الوريث يتفقّد ما وُهب له. هذا ما يفعله الرجال المسؤولون.

lines.speaker: Malik
lines.en: You will make the staff theatrical.

lines.speaker: Malik
lines.en: Come back when you have decided to be glad.
lines.ar: عُد حين تقرّر أن تكون مسرورًا.
